import pytest

from ansible.errors import AnsibleError
from ansible.plugins.lookup import import_module


def test_run_fetches_urls_and_splits_response_lines(monkeypatch):
    from ansible.plugins.lookup import url as url_lookup

    options = {
        "validate_certs": False,
        "use_proxy": False,
        "username": "user",
        "password": "secret",
        "headers": {"X-Test": "value"},
        "force": True,
        "timeout": 17,
        "http_agent": "test-agent",
        "force_basic_auth": True,
        "follow_redirects": "all",
        "use_gssapi": True,
        "unix_socket": "/tmp/socket",
        "ca_path": "/tmp/ca.pem",
        "unredirected_headers": ["Authorization"],
        "split_lines": True,
    }
    terms = ["https://one.example", "https://two.example"]
    responses = {
        terms[0]: [b"one", b"two"],
        terms[1]: [b"three", b"four"],

    set_options_calls = []

    class Response:
        def __init__(self, lines):
            self.lines = lines
            self.read_calls = 0

        def read(self):
            self.read_calls += 1
            return b"\n".join(self.lines)

    response_objects = {

        open_url_calls.append((term, kwargs))

    def fake_set_options(**kwargs):

    lookup = url_lookup.LookupModule()
    monkeypatch.setattr(url_lookup, "open_url", fake_open_url)
    monkeypatch.setattr(lookup, "set_options", fake_set_options)
    monkeypatch.setattr(lookup, "get_option", lambda name: options[name])

    result = lookup.run(terms, variables={"var": "value"}, request_id="123")

    expected_open_url_options = {
        "validate_certs": False,
        "use_proxy": False,
        "url_username": "user",
        "url_password": "secret",
        "headers": {"X-Test": "value"},
        "force": True,
        "timeout": 17,
        "http_agent": "test-agent",
        "force_basic_auth": True,
        "follow_redirects": "all",
        "use_gssapi": True,
        "unix_socket": "/tmp/socket",
        "ca_path": "/tmp/ca.pem",
        "unredirected_headers": ["Authorization"],
    }

    assert result == ["one", "two", "three", "four"]
    assert set_options_calls == [

    assert open_url_calls == [

        (terms[1], expected_open_url_options),

    assert all(response.read_calls == 1 for response in response_objects.values())

def test_run_translates_url_lookup_errors(monkeypatch, exception_name, message):
    from ansible.plugins.lookup import url as url_lookup

    class LookupFailure(Exception):
        pass

    options = {
        "validate_certs": True,
        "use_proxy": True,
        "username": None,
        "password": None,
        "headers": None,
        "force": False,
        "timeout": 10,
        "http_agent": None,
        "force_basic_auth": False,

        "unredirected_headers": None,
        "split_lines": True,
    }
    set_options_calls = []

    def fake_set_options(**kwargs):
        set_options_calls.append(kwargs)

    def fake_open_url(term, **kwargs):
        raise LookupFailure("failure")

    lookup = url_lookup.LookupModule()
    monkeypatch.setattr(url_lookup, exception_name, LookupFailure)
    monkeypatch.setattr(url_lookup, "open_url", fake_open_url)
    monkeypatch.setattr(lookup, "set_options", fake_set_options)
    monkeypatch.setattr(lookup, "get_option", lambda name: options[name])

    assert str(error.value) == message
    assert set_options_calls == [{"var_options": None, "direct": {}}]


def setattr_and_return(obj, name, value, result):
